title: A typed native detector with faster timing proposals
sample: 96 contiguous authentic dual-RX visits in four blocks · 288 warm calls per mode and role · 6 separate edge controls
boundary: Prepared dual CI16 through native preparation, proposals and complete fractional RF detection to typed and decoded rows on x86-64
note: All 1,530 stock and 1,533 fifth-center ordered candidates matched the released detector. Fifth-center decoded wall p50 35.05 to 33.68 ms and p95 43.73 to 42.68 ms. Both achieved 0 of 288 within 20 ms.
